faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about SharePrompt
faq.a1: SharePrompt is a community-driven platform where you can discover, share, and improve AI prompts. You can fork prompts, star your favorites, and build on each other's work.
faq.a2: A prompt is a text instruction you give to an AI model. A well-crafted prompt helps you get better, more consistent results.
faq.q3: How do I share a prompt?
faq.a3: Create a free account and click "Add Prompt". Fill in a title, description, category, and optional example output — then publish it instantly for the community.
faq.a4: Forking a prompt means creating your own version based on someone else's work. The original author is credited, and you can share your improvements with the community.
faq.q5: How is the contribution score calculated?
faq.a5: You earn 10 points for each prompt you share and 5 points for each star your prompts receive. Your total contribution score is displayed on your profile.
faq.a6: Yes, SharePrompt is completely free. Creating an account, sharing prompts, and accessing all features requires no payment whatsoever.
